                                                        <span class="sProvDot"></span>
                                                        <em>Explanatory Notes. (1)&#160;&#160;The entries in the second and sixth columns of this Schedule, headed respectively &#8220;Offence&#8221; and &#8220;Maximum punishment under the Penal Code&#160;1871&#8221; are not intended as definitions of the offences and punishments described in the several corresponding sections of the Penal Code&#160;1871, or even as abstracts of those sections, but merely as references to the subject of the section, the number of which is given in the first column. In the case of many offences punishable by fine the maximum fine is limited by the Penal Code&#160;1871; such offences are in the sixth column marked*</em>
